title: Indirect Hot Water Heater Installation on a Steam Boiler (This Old House)
summary: This Old House demonstrates converting a steam boiler that serves a house with radiant heat into a domestic hot water source by installing an indirect hot water heater. The video explains the limitations of boiler-derived hot water and then details an indirect tank with an internal coil that transfers heat from boiler water to a larger volume of potable water, eliminating the need for a direct-flame water heater. The program covers the tank’s construction (stainless steel, thick insulation), coil arrangement, filtration to protect the system, and the piping and valve hardware required (temperating valve, aquastat, relay, and circulator). summary: This Old House presenter explains how venting of gas appliances evolved from galvanized smoke pipe venting up a chimney to newer practices that vent exhaust horizontally to the outdoors.
